name: Reverse Linked List
description: Reverses a singly linked list in-place by changing next pointers. Uses three pointers (prev, curr, next) to reverse each link one at a time.
aim: Reverse all next pointers in a linked list so the last node becomes the head, using constant extra space.

time.bestCase: Single pass — must visit every node

complexity.spaceDescription: Three pointer variables — no extra allocation

realWorld: Undo operations — reverse history linked list
Palindrome linked list check (reverse second half)
whenToUse: When O(1) extra space is required
alternatives: Stack-based reversal — O(n) space but simpler code
Recursive reversal — elegant but O(n) stack space
Creating new list — O(n) space, cleaner but wasteful
